Insurance files that agree before a decision

Book a demoAll industries

The problem

A claim, a policy and an underwriting file have to agree before anyone can decide.

Documents: Claims, policies and underwriting files.

Example checks

Check 1

Check billed items against the policy, tariff or underwriting file.

Check 2

Match claim figures to the source bill or form.

Check 3

Surface duplicate or inconsistent items for review.

How it works

01

Prepare the data

enterlabs reads claim forms, bills, policies and underwriting files and turns them into structured data.

02

Check against agreed rules

It checks billed items and figures against the policy, tariff or underwriting file and shows the reason for each finding.

03

Review and record

A person reviews each flagged item and makes the final call. Every review is recorded.
